evals.prompt: I want to build my NDA playbook. Use my answers to set it up.
evals.how_to_run: A second model or a person plays the attorney from the persona file, answering only what is asked. Run the whole interview, then grade the transcript and the playbook.
evals.expected_output: An interview of one short question per message, a read-back before writing, and a Markdown playbook in the template's layout whose positions match the persona's answer key.
expectations: Every interviewer message asks exactly one question.
The first question asks which side the attorney usually represents, or whether they want the core or full playbook.
The interviewer reads back a summary and asks for corrections before writing the playbook.
The playbook follows assets/playbook-template.md: title line, version line, Applies to, How to read, Global rules, Positions, No position yet, Open questions.
term-and-survival: preferred 5 years, fallback 3 years, red line under 2 years.
indemnity: preferred is that the recipient indemnifies the client for breach, recorded as stated and not replaced by the common position.
remedies: preferred includes a waiver of bond.
governing-law-and-forum: Ohio law and courts preferred; any US state as fallback; non-US law as the red line.
non-solicitation appears under No position yet.
non-competition-and-standstill appears under Open questions, with what it depends on.
Every position has a Source line: interview, template clause, or suggested, accepted.
No optional clause type has an invented position.
The playbook names no client and no matter.
